description: Global Land Cover Change 2018 to 2050 is a dataset listed in FEMA Disaster Resilience Hub, a disaster resilience data hub, published or maintained by Esri. Beta Notice: This item is currently in beta and is intended for early access, testing, and feedback. It is not recommended for production use, as functionality and content are subject to change without notice. Coverage: United States. The hub lists this as a dataset of Esri. Its keywords are env1, landcover, 2050, 2018, change, esa, esri_environment, conservation. The bounding box given is -180.0000,-48.6135,180.0000,74.4651. The hub shows 2025-08-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-fema-resilience-hub.
